programme.desc: Interlinked in a love triangle, three childhood friends tumble into a courtroom drama when a printing press owned by one of them receives an inflated electricity bill.
programme.title: Batti Gul Meter Chalu

programme.desc: Aravind is a descendant of a martial arts expert, Bodhidharma. He must revive the fighting skills to stop Dong Lee, who comes to India to wage a biological war.
programme.title: Chennai vs China

programme.desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.
programme.title: Akhanda

programme.desc: Prem, who looks like Prince Yuvraj Vijay Singh, replaces him just before Vijay is to be crowned king. Although Vijay is engaged to Princess Maithili, she falls in love with Prem.
programme.title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo

programme.desc: Sushrut who runs a Garba academy falls in love with a beautiful NRI, Michelle, but her father creates a rift between the two. However, Sushrut is determined to win her back.
programme.title: Loveyatri

programme.desc: A young man with special needs is influenced by his father's scientific work. He encounters an alien who grants him extraordinary abilities and transforms his life.
programme.title: Koi ... Mil Gaya

programme.desc: A young farm girl, ensnared by a sinister stranger's lies, must wield the truth to rescue her family from impending danger.
programme.title: Snake

programme.desc: A hitman turns against his boss and decide to help an undercover police officer when he learns about his real identity.
programme.title: Bhai Mera Big Brother

programme.desc: When Aditya experiences anaesthesia awareness during his heart transplant surgery, he finds out the dirty ploy of his childhood friend Dr Suman and his wife Ria to kill him.
programme.title: Heartless

programme.desc: A police officer tries to change his younger brother, who turns to a life of crime, but he fails. He then takes on the local gangster responsible for inciting youngsters towards crime.
programme.title: Police Power

programme.desc: After a life-threatening accident, a man finds that he can communicate with the dead, and must decide whether to act on their advice.
programme.title: Masss

programme.desc: When a soldier lands in trouble due to his anger issues, he begins seeing a psychologist in hopes of one day returning to duty.
programme.title: Surya The Soldier

programme.desc: Azad fights against the systemic oppression of society. Soon, he finds himself in a web of deceit and crime as he teams up with a group of allies to take down a ruthless arms dealer.
programme.title: Jawaan

programme.desc: Shiva, a young man, is looked down upon by his father due to his irresponsible behaviour. He soon gets embroiled in a tussle with an egoistic gangster who threatens his family.
programme.title: Hero The Bullet

programme.desc: Forest officer Prajapati Pandey faces the heat when his wife, Aparna, catches him in suspicious situations with Chanchal and Nilofer.
programme.title: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do

programme.desc: Two men look alike, with one of them being a successful businessman and the other trying to find work. However, despite their differences, they end up falling for the same woman.
programme.title: Big Dhamaka

programme.desc: Praveen Patel, a 45-year-old married businessman, is tired of his religious wife though he loves her. However, things change after a younger actress wants to move in with him to prepare for a role.
programme.title: Kuch Kuch Locha Hai

programme.desc: Rajbir's wish to marry Gurpreet is delayed by his former wife, to whom he has to pay alimony until she remarries. Soon, he and his current partner hatch a plan to find her a potential suitor.
programme.title: Second Hand Husband

programme.desc: A hitman sets out to rescue his boss's mistress and send her back to her boyfriend after learning that she is a victim of sex trafficking.
programme.title: Awarapan

programme.desc: Jhanvi and Siddharth fall in love with each other. However, things take a dangerous turn when Ganpat, her brother, does not favour their relationship and plans to kill Siddharth.
programme.title: Run

programme.desc: After graduating from a university in India, an unemployed man decides to try his luck in New York and gets caught in a love triangle between an equally unlucky girl and a rich girl.
programme.title: Aa Ab Laut Chalein

programme.desc: Prem and Suman fall in love with each other, only to be torn apart by family differences. However, Suman's father is willing to give Prem one last chance where he must prove himself worthy of Suman.
programme.title: Maine Pyar Kiya

programme.desc: A charitable trust faces threats from a powerful mafia leader who has set his eyes on its land. He plans to kill the legal heir to grab the wealth, but a brave taxi driver becomes an impediment.
programme.title: Supreme Khiladi

programme.desc: Ramaswamy, who works as a front-end receptionist for Union Minister Viswanathan, decides to pursue civil service. Soon, Viswanathan's daughter falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.
programme.title: Saamy 2

programme.desc: Three friends travel to a small town where they meet Ragini, a gorgeous woman. However, their life changes as Ragini brings nothing but trouble to them.
programme.title: Great Grand Masti

programme.desc: Seeking to achieve something significant in life, Tarla Dalal rebels against societal expectations to empower herself and other women through the art of cooking.
programme.title: Tarla

programme.desc: A journalist relentlessly investigates to uncover the truth behind the sudden and mysterious disappearance of a young activist.
programme.title: Lost

programme.desc: The Fukras plan to take over Delhi and run for city elections. However, they have no money, so they take on an international job to make a quick buck, which changes their lives forever.
programme.title: Fukrey 3

programme.desc: A widow decides to seek the help of her husband's spirit when she sees the marital life of her son shattering in front of her.
programme.title: The Return of Raju

programme.desc: Embracing his role as the provider, Lala Kedarnath puts personal romantic interests on the back burner until his quirky sisters can be married off into loving families.
programme.title: Raksha Bandhan

programme.desc: Kishorilal wants an Indian bride for his NRI son; he gets him engaged to Ganga, his friend's daughter. However, she seems to share a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son.
programme.title: Pardes

programme.desc: A money-minded tycoon gets into a beneficial relationship with a woman. Soon, he learns about the differences in his family and decides to end them.
programme.title: Businessman 2

programme.desc: An honest Income Tax officer, Amay Patnaik, confronts the corrupt nexus in Bhoj. Beneath the veneer of honesty lies a sinister operation tied to Dada Bhai, a revered politician.
programme.title: Raid 2

programme.desc: After committing a robbery, Basava and his companion, John, run into Agraharam Geetha, a stranger, and the trio end up in Bhairavakona, a village shrouded in mystery.
programme.title: Bhairavakona

programme.desc: Three friends in their twenties, Imaad, Ahana, and Neil, try to figure out life in an ever-changing digital era. So, through love and heartbreak, they find support in each other.
programme.title: Kho Gaye Hum Kahan

programme.desc: Debika Chatterjee, an Indian woman living in Norway with her family, fights to regain custody of her children after Norwegian authorities take them away from her.
programme.title: Mrs. Chatterjee vs Norway

programme.desc: When Bramble merges with an alien artefact, he gains incredible abilities. With Avi by his side, he embarks on a high-stakes journey to defend their home from an intergalactic danger.

programme.title: News Special

programme.desc: Rahul's boss, Siddharth, is a womaniser who exploits Rahul into helping him win over Seema. However, Rahul ends up falling for Seema and is torn between his career aspirations and her.
programme.title: Yes Boss

programme.desc: Renu helps Raju acquire a job in her company and later, they both fall in love with each other. However, things take a turn when his success makes him arrogant.
programme.title: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman

programme.desc: Kishorilal wants an Indian bride for his NRI son; he gets him engaged to Ganga, his friend's daughter. However, she seems to share a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son.
programme.title: Pardes

programme.desc: Silenced by a piece of smouldering coal in childhood, Shankar endures a life of slavery until love compels him to seek his voice, freedom, and long-overdue revenge.
programme.title: Koyla

programme.desc: Karan and Arjun, two brothers driven by revenge, are murdered by their uncle while seeking justice for their father's death. However, they resurrect years later to settle their unfinished score.
programme.title: Karan Arjun

programme.desc: ACP Prithviraj, an honest man, arrests Chief Minister Baburao's son for raping a woman. Consequently, Baburao leaves no stone unturned to get revenge against Prithviraj.
programme.title: Kurukshetra

programme.desc: After Vijay, a young army cadet, finds evidence against the corrupt officer, Gautam, he gets entangled in a never-ending battle with the police, which puts his career and his family in trouble.
programme.title: Salaami

programme.desc: An officer has a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. While attempting to gather evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But, they are not aware of the gangster's secrets.
programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha

programme.desc: A wealthy businessman's son manipulates a loyal friend into his personal schemes, but unexpected love and rising tensions threaten to unravel their lives.
programme.title: Gaddaar

programme.desc: Radha and Govinda are in love with each other and get married. Post the wedding, their life goes awry when Govinda is arrested, leaving Radha to tackle problems all alone.
programme.title: Radha Ka Sangam

programme.desc: Ganga and Gauri anger an evil tantric by saving Nagaraj. Enraged, the tantric turns Gauri into stone and kills Ganga. Nagaraj blesses Ganga with rebirth and helps unite him with his love.
programme.title: Prem Shakti

programme.desc: Duryodhan, a wrestler, is Raju's friend, but due to a misunderstanding he rapes and kills Raju's sister. Raju later seeks Baba Thakur's help to train in fighting to avenge his sister's death.
programme.title: Jigar

programme.desc: Balwant Rai, a corrupt businessman, frames Ajay for the murder of his brother. Later, with no support from those close to him, Ajay takes an unlikely route to seek revenge.
programme.title: Ghayal

programme.desc: Balraj, an honest man, joins hands with a gangster in order to avenge his father's death. However, his upstanding brother Ajay opposes him as a police inspector.
programme.title: Tada

programme.desc: Badal, a simple village boy, falls for his classmate Tina. However, Tina's father does not approve of their relationship and conspires to separate them.
programme.title: Barsaat

programme.desc: After being rejected by Sahibaan, Vijay, a philanderer, learns about her love affair with Gopi, a labourer. Soon, a distressed Vijay decides to kill Gopi.
programme.title: Sahibaan

programme.desc: After Shyamsunder presumes that his first wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he learns that Pooja is alive, he has to juggle between his wives, keeping both his marriages a secret.
programme.title: Saajan Chale Sasural

programme.desc: When the good doctor Vijay is falsely accused and imprisoned, his wife and daughter, desperately seeking justice, are terrorised and slandered by the harsh eyes of society.
programme.title: Kudrat Ka Kanoon

programme.desc: Inspector Ram succeeds in nabbing notorious criminal Ballu. When Ballu's escape taints Ram's name, his fiancée, Ganga, decides to trap Ballu. But, things get complicated when Ballu starts liking her.
programme.title: Khal Nayak

programme.desc: After a series of tragedies shake Manorama's life, Devdhar, her childhood friend who falls for her, vows to make her happy. In the process, he faces the wrath of Manorama's conservative family.
programme.title: Prem Rog

programme.desc: A mysterious person vigilantly protects Vijay and his mother from notorious goons. His reasons for protecting them remain an unresolved enigma.
programme.title: The Don

programme.desc: Sisters, Mansi and Bansi, face a setback in their relationship when Mansi becomes a popular singer and gets Bansi married to an ill-suited man.
programme.title: Saaz

programme.desc: Jai Kishen is an aspiring police officer who marries his girlfriend against his parents' wishes. Meanwhile, MLA Sadakhare hires a few men to carry out a bomb blast.
programme.title: Bomb Blast

programme.desc: Arjun and Shivani are in love, but Shivani's father will never let them marry each other. Later chaos ensues when Arjun enlists the help of his conman cousin, Kishan, to unite him with Shivani.
programme.title: Apna Sapna Money Money

programme.desc: Amid the grim shadows of cross-border terrorism in India, love shines bright, guiding troubled army man Gaurav and village belle Sanam towards each other.
programme.title: Sanam

programme.desc: Two siblings, Vijay and Durga, vow to avenge the death of their parents. So, Durga becomes an inspector to punish the criminals, whereas Vijay breaks the law to achieve his goal.
programme.title: Andha Kanoon

programme.desc: Dev Kumar, a police inspector, finds himself in a dilemma when has to arrest a notorious criminal who also happens to the father of his childhood friend, Guru.
programme.title: Gurudev

programme.desc: A ruthless landlord exiles Bheema due to his rebellion against him. However, when his nephew is abducted, Bheema sets out to gain the support of the villagers and rescue the boy.
programme.title: Aaj Ka Arjun

programme.desc: Anju endures mistreatment at home, whereas her long-separated twin Manju boldly navigates life's challenges. By some quirk of fate, they end up trading places, and their worlds erupt in chaos.
programme.title: Chaalbaaz

programme.desc: Ajay, a photographer, falls for Anita, a model and his colleague who is engaged to another man. However, his love turns into obsession when he mistakes her friendship for love.
programme.title: Deewana Mujh Sa Nahin

programme.desc: Sevalal, a corrupt minister, kills Vishal, an honest police officer. So Vishal's brother Jugnu vows to avenge his death.
programme.title: Jaagruti

programme.desc: A wrongfully convicted policewoman expects her three children to settle scores with her enemy. But when the long-awaited moment arrives, luck does not seem to be on her side.
programme.title: Trimurti

programme.desc: A businessman disowns his spoiled son, Aditya, after he marries a girl from a rival family. Upon discovering his father's lung cancer, Aditya resolves to change for the better.
programme.title: Waqt: The Race Against Time

programme.desc: Brothers Suraj and Deepak work for the police as a havildar and a traffic constable respectively. However, they soon turn against each other when Deepak testifies in favour of a criminal.
programme.title: Muqabla

programme.desc: Suraj secretly marries Shalu, a village belle, against his domineering mother Kamla's wishes. In a bid to get rid of Shalu, Kamla frames her and accuses her of stealing jewellery and money.
programme.title: Biwi Ho To Aisi

programme.desc: Love leads Ajay down a new path when he is expected to inherit his father's criminal empire, bringing along perils that could either tear their family apart or solidify their bond.
programme.title: Phool Aur Kaante

programme.desc: Don, a wanted criminal, succumbs to his injuries in a police chase. Things take a turn when Vijay, a lookalike of Don, replaces him and tries to trace the details of his illegal activities.
programme.title: Don

programme.desc: Dharma, a dangerous hoodlum, embarks on a quest for revenge after he gets arrested and learns that the chief witness behind the case is his sister's husband.
programme.title: Paap Ki Aandhi

programme.desc: In the kaleidoscopic cityscapes of Banaras, a soul-stirring Romeo-and-Juliet-esque romance kindles between two young individuals from rival mafia families.
programme.title: Issaq

programme.desc: Ravi works for Veljibhai Soda, a gangster, and does illegal work for him. Once, he is asked to vacate Ali from his property, but he gets inspired by his ideals and decides to change his ways.
programme.title: Kabzaa

programme.desc: Pritam and Banu, two shape-shifting snakes in human form, seek protection from a young man when an evil priest tries to hunt them down and use them in a ritual for wealth and immortality.
programme.title: Sheshnaag

programme.desc: While Kishen enjoys village life and romance with Radha, a sinister doppelgänger plots. Upon returning home, he'll discover his identity and life stolen by this malevolent impostor.
programme.title: Bol Radha Bol

programme.desc: A naive village girl marries the son of a domineering man. However, upon her arrival at his house in the city, she finds out that he is already married.
programme.title: Naseeb Apna Apna

programme.desc: Widowed Aarti falls prey to Sanjay's vicious plan of getting married to him. Later, with the help of her best friend Nandini, he drowns Aarti and seizes her wealth, but she survives and seeks revenge.
programme.title: Khoon Bhari Maang

programme.desc: Star-crossed lovers connect, only to be torn apart by familial obligations. They part ways reluctantly, clinging to the dream of a future reunion.
programme.title: Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri

programme.desc: Ravi Kapoor, a police officer and Sonu Dada, a former criminal, join hands together to take down a notorious gangster, Chandi Das.
programme.title: Nafrat Ki Aandhi
